english_summary: Distinguishes interviews with transport workers from the committee members’ own visits. The committee reports a luminous full figure moving above the dome,bowing toward the cross and blessing the crowd;also luminous dove forms. The exact dates of the members’ full-figure observations are not supplied in this passage.
literal_translation: And bows toward the cross and blesses.
